reviews.content: I stumbled across this windhawk mod earlier today, and it's honestly been a game changer, I used to use windows clock but that requires the notifications service to be running (which I did not want running because it's quite resource intensive). However, now I can set all my reminders, tasks, etc and add notes in a handy and fluent menu just one click away! And what I love is that this does not invoke the notifications service at all and instead runs it's own UI and stuff which makes it light and fast.
